items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Oh I love his playing. And Geri Allen. They are performing well, it’s just that there’s not enough of it.

ctx.x: Oh I love his playing. And Geri Allen. They are performing well, it’s just that there’s not enough of it. When I was young that’s all you heard was jazz, jazz bands, and rhythm & blues bands, like Roy Milton and those kind of groups. But you don’t hear too much of it now.
Is there much of a live jazz scene in L.A. these days?
